independent_integrity.interpretation: The false value is intentional evidence that the frozen Julia assessment/summary disagrees with exact independent recomputation; it is not a source, checkpoint, work-ledger or numerical-operand replay failure.

reconstructed_results.shared_failure_pattern: For all four groups, both candidate and analytic control reject the orthogonal-variable-and-residual-rotation representation at the trajectory final applicability audit while promoting the independent signed/permuted and equivalent DAG representations.

frozen_assessor_bug.cause: The frozen Julia assessor narrows evidence endpoints, targets, Gold configurations and Gold targets to Float64 before differencing. Four regular-fold target errors between 3.3333333333333333e-18 and 3.3333333333333335e-17 round to zero at the surrounding target scale, so the persisted rows incorrectly report Gold success and no false promotion.
frozen_assessor_bug.independent_decision: Decimal recomputation marks all four S1 promotions false, with target-error undercoverage. No S4 candidate/control assessment differs from independent recomputation.
frozen_assessor_bug.effect_on_summary: variant_summaries, advancement_gate and promoted evidence-failure fields are invalid in the frozen summary; the independent reconstruction is authoritative for closure.

decision.action: Reject the frozen S4 candidate at development. Do not retune, open locked inputs or connect either S4 mechanism to product code.
decision.research_value: The two-step map is materially promising and independently replicated: it gains 73.3 percentage points over the exact baseline reconstruction with zero S4 false promotions and exact candidate/control decision agreement. Its current final applicability/stop interaction is nevertheless representation-sensitive and misses the registered recall threshold.
decision.reopen_gate: A new preregistered successor must use exact/non-narrowing Gold assessment, preserve endpoint-global budgets and all control-strata rejections, recover at least 12/15 on a fresh family-disjoint development split, and eliminate the orthogonal-representation final-audit disagreement before any locked validation.
